intro.h2: Why Jupiter kitchen remodeling works better with one team
paragraphs: Palmhouse Design & Build has handled kitchen remodeling Jupiter FL homeowners trust since 2005, along with baths, interiors and whole-home renovations across Palm Beach County. Co-founders Oscar and Rosie Barrig lead the company alongside Jonathan and Gabriel Barrig, both Certified General Contractors.

Every project gets a Design Consultant, an Interior Designer and a Project Manager. Design, budgeting, scheduling and construction stay under one roof, so the plan that gets drawn is the plan that gets built. The firm says plainly that it is not the lowest-price option. It is for homeowners who want clear communication and a fully managed process.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and whole homes across Palm Beach County

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchens reshaped around how your household cooks and gathers, from layout and cabinetry to counters, lighting and appliances. Floor plans, elevations and digital renderings let you see the room first, and the specifications give a complete cost analysis before you sign.

image.alt: Jupiter kitchen remodel with white oak cabinets, glossy white tile, plaster range hood, black pantry wall and woven pendants

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Spa-style primary baths, guest baths and powder rooms, with tub and shower installation, tile, vanities and lighting. Your Interior Designer guides selections in the Palmhouse Design Studio, and the same contracting team that permitted the job builds it.

image.alt: High-end bathroom renovation by Palmhouse with a freestanding soaking tub, navy walls, botanical wallpaper and brass fixtures

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Custom cabinets for kitchens, baths and storage throughout the home. For kitchen projects where the layout already works, custom cabinets are also offered as a stand-alone service, built to fit your existing footprint without a full remodel.

image.alt: Jupiter kitchen with walnut slab cabinets, integrated refrigerator panels, white quartz waterfall island and globe pendants

items.name: Interior Design and Whole-Home Renovation
items.blurb: Floor plans, material palettes and finish selections handled in-house, from a single room to a full house. The team orders products, tracks deliveries and gives weekly ETAs, and out-of-state owners can run a full remodel virtually by Zoom, Google Meet, email and text.

image.alt: Modern Jupiter interior with white upper cabinets, walnut lower cabinets, dark glass tile backsplash and stainless range hood

items.name: Exteriors and Outdoor Living
items.blurb: Stucco repair, exterior painting, impact windows and doors, reroofing, gutters, pavers and patio summer kitchens, finished for the Florida climate. One Jupiter backyard went from bare lawn to a new pool with a tiled spa and paver deck.

image.alt: Before and after backyard renovation in Jupiter, FL: bare lawn turned into a pool with tiled spa and paver deck

why_choose_us.h2: What Palm Beach County homeowners get with Palmhouse

items.title: Line-by-line pricing
items.text: You get a detailed, line-by-line estimate before work begins, and the construction agreement spells out the timeline, payment schedule, approved specifications, drawings and final budget.

items.text: Daily jobsite cleaning, dust control systems and floor and surface protection are standard. A Google reviewer noted the crew cleaned up the work area at the end of each day.

about.text: Oscar Barrig co-founded Palmhouse and serves as managing partner, bringing more than three decades of contracting and building experience. Co-founder Rosie Barrig has over 30 years in administration and residential space planning and keeps every project organized, so spaces come out both good-looking and highly functional. Jonathan and Gabriel Barrig are Certified General Contractors who manage projects and handle budgeting, local codes, universal design and energy efficiency. Reviewers mention Oscar by name, and one said he and his team are "respectful, timely, and talented at what they do."

image.alt: Oscar Barrig, co-founder of Palmhouse Design & Build in Jupiter, FL

process.h2: How a Palmhouse remodel moves from consultation to keys

steps.title: Complimentary consultation
steps.text: A Design Consultant meets you at home to talk through goals and budget and suggest solutions. Out-of-state owners can start by phone or video.

steps.title: Design and planning
steps.text: Your Design Consultant and Interior Designer photograph and measure the home, then draw a custom plan around the way you live.

steps.title: Presentation and agreement
steps.text: You review floor plans, elevations, renderings and a full cost analysis, then sign a construction agreement with timeline, payment schedule and final budget.

steps.title: Selections and permits
steps.text: You choose finishes in the client-only Design Studio while the team orders products and secures HOA approvals and permits.

steps.title: Construction and finish
steps.text: A weekly schedule keeps you informed during the build. At the end, your design fee is credited to the final bill and a two-year warranty begins.

service_area.h2: From Jupiter Island to Palm Beach
service_area.text: Palmhouse works from its Maplewood Drive showroom in Jupiter across northern Palm Beach County and beyond. That includes Tequesta, Juno Beach and Jupiter Island to the north, and Palm Beach Gardens communities such as BallenIsles, Mirasol, PGA National and Old Palm. It also covers waterfront work in North Palm Beach and historic and oceanfront estates on Palm Beach Island, where HOA review and access coordination are part of every plan.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodeling Jupiter FL questions we hear most

items.q: How will I know what my remodel costs?
items.a: Before construction you get a line-by-line estimate. At the design presentation, the specifications give a complete cost analysis of the plan. Once you approve it, the construction agreement lists the timeline, payment schedule, approved specifications, drawings and final budget, so the numbers are settled before work starts.

Yes. The first meeting is a complimentary consultation at your home with a Design Consultant to discuss goals, budget and possible solutions. If you move forward, design work begins under a retainer, and your design fee is credited toward your final bill when the project is finished.

items.q: Do you work in gated and golf communities?
items.a: Yes. Palmhouse has completed renovations in Palm Beach Gardens communities including BallenIsles, Mirasol and PGA National. The team prepares construction-ready documents and handles the HOA approvals, permits and access coordination these neighborhoods require, as well as waterfront planning in North Palm Beach.

items.q: Can you manage my remodel while I am out of state?
items.a: Yes. Many clients are snowbirds or own vacation homes in Florida. Palmhouse has completed full house remodels while meeting clients by Google Meet, Zoom, email and text. Each week you get clear ETAs for deliveries and key milestones, so you can follow progress from anywhere.

Palmhouse backs its work with a two-year warranty that starts when your project is complete. The company is a licensed general contractor in Florida, carries insurance, and lists BBB accreditation and memberships in the National Association of Home Builders and the Florida Home Builders Association.

final_cta.h2: Start your kitchen with a free consultation
final_cta.text: Call (561) 831-4170 to book a complimentary in-home consultation, or visit the showroom at 801 Maplewood Dr in Jupiter.
